requiredProperties.$comment: SharedProperty type IDs REQUIRED by the MFE

actions.$comment: Action type IDs this entry is capable of receiving and executing. Must include every action in the target domain's extensionsActions.

domainActions.$comment: Action type IDs the parent extension domain must support for this entry to be injectable. Each one, apart from the infrastructure lifecycle actions (load_ext, mount_ext, unmount_ext), must appear in the domain's actions.
